title: NewsReX: An Open-Source Multi-Framework for Neural News Recommendation
abstract: arXiv:2508.21572v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Reproducing and comparing results in neural news recommendation research remains difficult due to fragmented codebases, inconsistent preprocessing pipelines, and tight coupling between models and deep learning frameworks. We present NewsReX, an open-source framework that unifies multiple neural news recommendation models across two ML backends (PyTorch and JAX/Flax). Models are defined through a structured YAML specification that captures architecture, training recipe, and data contract, decoupling model definition from framework-specific implementation. A Hydra-based configuration system enables composable experiments with single-command framework switching. We provide cross-framework parity tests to verify numerical consistency across backends, allowing researchers to reproduce results from the original implementations and then transfer experiments to their preferred framework. We report comprehensive experiments on the MIND-small

translated_title: NewsReX：一个开源的神经新闻推荐多框架
translated_abstract: 由于代码库碎片化、预处理流程不一致，以及模型与深度学习框架之间的紧密耦合，神经新闻推荐研究中的结果复现与比较仍然十分困难。我们提出了 NewsReX，这是一个开源框架，它在两个机器学习后端（PyTorch 和 JAX/Flax）上统一了多种神经新闻推荐模型。模型通过结构化的 YAML 规范来定义，该规范涵盖模型架构、训练方案和数据契约，从而将模型定义与特定框架的实现解耦。基于 Hydra 的配置系统支持可组合的实验，只需一条命令即可完成框架切换。我们提供了跨框架一致性测试来验证各后端之间的数值一致性，使研究人员能够复现原始实现的结果，然后将实验迁移到他们偏好的框架上。我们在 MIND-small 数据集上报告了全面的实验。
tldr: NewsReX 是一个开源的多框架神经新闻推荐系统，通过 YAML 模型规范和 Hydra 配置系统统一了多种推荐模型，支持 PyTorch 与 JAX/Flax 两个后端间的单命令切换与数值一致性验证，解决了该领域结果复现与比较困难的问题。
en_tdlr: NewsReX is an open-source multi-framework for neural news recommendation that unifies multiple models across PyTorch and JAX/Flax backends using structured YAML specifications and Hydra configurations, enabling single-command framework switching with verified numerical parity to address reproducibility challenges.
